title: Chapter 11 Alchemy Guild — Recursive Hybrid Tool Forge
authority: guild-hall meta quest under current user + repository authority ceilings
source_laws: S11 Crucible of Alchemy: convert partial modules into one bootable subsystem
Chapter 11 is the manufacturing origin / forge of future structure
11->21 expands the seed into the completed future body
21->12'->11' rewrites the seed using knowledge of the crown
10->1 descends speculative objects into known math, code, software, proof, or explicit residual
winning_condition: Each generation converts one extreme fictional capability ceiling into at least one claimable, testable, repo-backed advancement and emits a successor seed from observed residuals rather than replaying the original fantasy.

roles.Dreamsmith: creates the maximum-power fictional capability spec and extracts typed capability verbs
roles.CrucibleArchitect: selects orthogonal real parent systems and designs the fusion topology
roles.CrownCartographer: performs Chapter 11->21 future expansion and defines the completed system/proof shape
roles.DescentEngineer: grounds crown objects into known math, algorithms, code, software, APIs, data, repositories, or explicit research gaps
roles.PrototypeSmith: builds the smallest high-information artifact that demonstrates a nontrivial hybrid operation
roles.Adversary: searches for contradictions, impossible dependencies, reward hacks, unsafe assumptions, scaling failures, and simpler baselines
roles.Witness: replays tests and records observations without upgrading predictions into evidence
roles.ReSeeder: compresses verified gain plus residual into the next generation and retires empty loops

SPARK.objective: invent and compile one new hybrid into a falsifiable MVP quest

CRUCIBLE.objective: turn a promising hybrid into a working subsystem with adapters, contracts, benchmarks, and replay receipts

PHILOSOPHER.objective: measure the forge itself, compare generations, compress productive fusion patterns, and retire decorative complexity

generation_equations.parents: P_t = RETRIEVE_PRIMITIVES(V_t, Git, corpus, tools, math, software)

anti_loop_rules: No empty reseed: successor generation requires durable gain or reusable falsification
No self-awarded truth: scores and generated evaluations do not create evidence
No authority minting: a proposed tool only has permissions actually granted by its runtime
No complexity worship: a hybrid must create a useful native operation or be rejected
No fantasy laundering: dramatic specification must progressively descend into testable interfaces and explicit unknowns
No stale continuation: rehydrate current heads before consequential mutation
reseed_condition: After every witnessed or falsified generation, select the highest-value uncovered residual, compress lineage/evidence into a successor seed, and post the next claimable quest; retire the lineage if no reusable delta was produced.
